cloud_model.description: Cloud model for the plan and live sample reads; the app accepts only its allowlist

min_group_size.description: Smallest group size shown in the class totals (the app never goes below 3)

cloud_features_enabled.description: Kill switch for every cloud call

sample_cloud_live_reads.description: Live cloud reads of made-up sample sheets per run (0 to 3); 0 keeps the shared free quota for lesson plans
